name: uv
description: Installs uv — an extremely fast Python package and project manager. Centralises Python interpreter and package caches under a named Docker volume for faster rebuilds.

version.description: Version of uv to install (e.g. '0.11.17'). Use 'latest' for the current release.

toolsToInstall.description: Comma-separated list of CLI tools to install with uv tool install. Set to empty string to skip tool installation.
